AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Aug-09-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald J. Sullivan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Sonia Wong #11288.

Petitioner April Abbie Lillis present in pro per as guardian ad litem for the minor Isaiah Stephen Howes, was placed under oath and examined.
Copy of the filed declaration by Minor's father William F. Howes III, consenting to the name change of the minor was presented in open court.
Proof of Publication is in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name of a minor were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to Esaiah Stephen Howes.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
